sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/30 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/place for PlaceId 30, search/grid + search/details for all 51 units of facility 139 Smith Mountain Lake Campground, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/smith-mountain-lake ('Sites EW 50ft BackIn and EW 50ftPulThru have water and electric hookups. 20 and 30 amp service is available.', 'Sewer hookups are not available.') + reservevaparks.com site details (all 24 Electric/Water units: Electric Hookup 30, Water Hookup Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 50 sites, all in the woods, none waterfront: 24 water/electric (19 back-in, 5 pull-through) for RVs up to 50 ft, and 26 tents-only sites with a shared parking lot. The booking site lists vehicle lengths of 35-70 ft on the RV sites; DCR's own page says up to 50 ft. Pull-throughs are recommended for large RVs or larger boats.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/smith-mountain-lake ('Fifty sites; all in the woods; no waterfront', 'Total sites of each type : EW 50ft BackIn, 19; EW 50ftPulThru, 5; Tent Std, 26', 'Tent/van/pop-up/camper/RV up to 50 feet') + reservevaparks.com grid (24 Electric/Water units, VehicleLength 35-70; 5 Pull Through), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Full-service bathhouse with hot showers. Dump station free for campers in the park. 'The closest Laundromat is 15 minutes away.' Generators prohibited at all times. Firewood sold; do not bring firewood. Boat launching free for overnight guests.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/smith-mountain-lake ('Full-service bathhouse with hot showers', 'A dump station is available free of charge for campers', 'LAUNDRY: The closest Laundromat is 15 minutes away', 'Generators are prohibited at all times'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All sites are site-specific.' 'Reservations are strongly encouraged during prime season.' Reserve online (ReserveVAParks) or 800-933-PARK. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on every campsite. Late arrivals follow the posted late-arrival process when the office (weekdays 8-4) is closed.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/smith-mountain-lake ('All sites are site-specific', 'Reservations are strongly encouraged during prime season', 'When the office is closed guests should follow the late arrival process') + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all units), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the $37 electric/water rate (booking site, 2027-05-04) and the season (DCR: first Friday in March to first Monday of December), both already recorded. Added 30-amp with water, no sewer, 50 sites (24 RV, 26 tent-only) to 50 ft with 5 pull-throughs, showers, dump, no laundry, 14-night max. Window/cutoff left inherited (not stated for this park).
